newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Nov heat oil sets contract 73.5 cts/gal high.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Nov heat oil sets contract 73.5 cts/gal high.

text.p: NYMEX November heating oil set a new contract high Thursday morning of 73.50 cents a gallon on a fresh round of weather-related commission house buying, traders said.

"It's low stocks, cold weather, and it's still technical strength. What can you say"? said one analyst of the latest move, which knocked out the previous post-Gulf War high of 73.15 cents a gallon made during Wednesday's session.
